provider: ghproxy mirrors (ghproxy.net, ghfast.top) — free anonymous GitHub raw/release proxy

free_tier.stated: GitHub文件链接带不带协议头都可以，支持release、archive以及文件，右键复制出来的链接都是符合标准的，更多用法、clone加速请参考这篇文章。

egress.terms: Free, anonymous, no key. These are community-run mirrors of the GitHub CDN, funded by volunteers. Hence the polyculture of hostnames (gh-proxy.com, ghproxy.net, ghfast.top, gh.api.99988866.xyz) and the constant churn.

tooling: Prefix form: https://ghproxy.net/https://raw.githubusercontent.com/<owner>/<repo>/<ref>/<path> and .../https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>/releases/download/<tag>/<asset>. Nothing else to install.
chaining: Serves as an edge mirror for GitHub release assets alongside raw file mirrors. Proxies allow distributing reads across ghproxy.net, ghfast.top, and other mirrors for public release downloads.
limits_note: Per-IP bandwidth shaping restricts download rates. Probes observed approximately 128 KB/s on file retrieval, compared to higher throughput from alternative CDN endpoints.
reliability_note: Treat as a bandwidth multiplier for large files, never as an availability guarantee. Their own issue trackers document the churn (hunshcn/gh-proxy#116 mirror list, 'ghproxy.com 打不开了').

evidence.proved: HTTP 200, Content-Length 50,901,339, correct prefix bytes; throughput ~128 KB/s (probed)
and https://cdn.gitmirror.com/gh/… — connection failed / 0 bytes (probed, dead)
